import json
# final targeted regression on tricky audit semantics from the spec text
cases = []
# 1: whole-SCC heuristic trap: fair subcycle in SCC with strong action whose only exits leave the SCC
c = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[0]]],"start":0,
     "edges":[[0,"w",1],[1,"w",0],[1,"q",2],[2,"z",0],[2,"a",3]],
     "states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[[0]]],"slots":[]}],
     "fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"strong"}]}
cases.append(c)
# 2: weak-only version
cases.append(dict(c, fairness=[{"action":"c","mode":"weak"}]))
# 3: no fairness, loss self-loop only
cases.append({"op":"audit","inputs":[[[0]]],"start":0,"edges":[[0,"loss",0]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"fairness":[]})
# 4: strong fair subcycle deeper: chain with exits
c4 = {"op":"audit","inputs":[[[0]]],"start":0,
      "edges":[[0,"a",1],[1,"x",1],[1,"b",2],[2,"c",0],[0,"y",0]],
      "states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]},{"delivered":[[[9]]],"slots":[]}],
      "fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"strong"},{"action":"y","mode":"weak"}]}
cases.append(c4)
# 5: barrier D=0 exact sums
c5={"op":"audit","inputs":[[[],[]],[[],[]]],"start":0,"edges":[[0,"p",1],[1,"p",2]],
    "states":[{"delivered":[[],[]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[]}]},
              {"delivered":[[],[]],"slots":[]},
              {"delivered":[[],[]],"slots":[]}],
    "fairness":[]}
cases.append(c5)
# 6: unsafe slot sums with negative ranks
c6={"op":"audit","inputs":[[[[-5],[7]],[[3],[0]]],[[[5],[0]],[[9],[-2]]]],"start":0,"edges":[],
    "states":[{"delivered":[[[0,0],[0,0]],[[0,0],[0,0]]],"slots":[{"seq":1,"ranks":[1,0],"sum":[0,0]}]}],
    "fairness":[]}
cases.append(c6)
open("/app/tmp/t/final.jsonl","w").write("\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cases)+"\n")
EOF
